header.title: Particle Rain
header.description: Falling confetti, sparks, stars, or lights over the child. It emits waves of particles from the top edge, in a decorative layer (`pointer-events: none`) clipped to the root. `trigger` sets when it rains (`always`, `hover`, `click`, or `hold`), `variant` sets the look, and `span` how long emission lasts. It uses the Particles layer, so it needs `particles.css`.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Combine props and see the generated code. With `click` and `hold`, interact with the box. `span` set to `auto` emits without limit (or `1400` ms with `click`).
playground.label: Party

base.title: Basic rain
base.description: With the defaults (`trigger="always"`, `variant="confetti"`, `intensity="md"`) a wave of `6` paper bits falls every `110` ms and each takes `1800` ms. The root clips with `overflow: hidden`, so size, radius, and background go on the root. Default palettes are light: on light backgrounds, pass `colors`.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `confetti` is spinning paper bits, `spark` thin glowing streaks, `star` four-point sparkles, and `light` glowing orbs that grow and fade. `mixed` picks a random shape per particle, with the `confetti` palette.

image.title: On an image
image.description: The rain sits over any content. The layer has `aria-hidden` and `pointer-events: none`, so it doesn't interfere with alt text or clicks. The root's radius clips both the image and the particles.

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description: With `hover` it rains while the pointer is over it or the root has keyboard focus. With `click`, each click (or Enter or Space) starts a `1400` ms shower (`span`) and another click restarts it. With `hold` it rains while the pointer or key is pressed; the pointer isn't captured, so children get their click, and the root sets `touch-action: none` so touch doesn't scroll. Each box here has `tabIndex={0}` so you can try them with Tab. When it stops, particles already falling finish their path.

span.title: Emission span
span.description: `span` is how long emission lasts once it starts, in milliseconds. With `click` it's `1400` when omitted; with `always`, `hover`, and `hold` it emits without limit until it turns off. Not to be confused with `duration`, which is each particle's fall time.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: `colors` takes a palette and particles take its colors in order. `color` is a single color, used when `colors` is omitted. Without either, each variant uses its default palette. Prefer tokens.

count.title: Count
count.description: `count` sets particles per wave (`1` to `24`) and wins over `intensity`. Since there's a wave every `interval` ms, density depends on both. The live-particle cap scales with `count`, so the rain keeps a steady flow.

spread.title: Drift
spread.description: `spread` is how far each particle drifts sideways while falling, in pixels (randomly left or right). With `0` they fall straight down. Without `spread`, `intensity` sets it: `18`, `36`, or `56`.

duration.title: Fall duration
duration.description: `duration` is how long each particle takes to cross the root, in milliseconds. Higher is a slower rain. Particles fade as they fall.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: Without `count` or `spread`, `intensity` sets both: `3`, `6`, or `10` particles per wave with `18`, `36`, or `56` px of drift. It also takes a number from `0` to `1`. The live-particle cap fits the steady stream (`ceil((duration + 210) / interval + 1) × count`: `60`, `120`, or `200` with the defaults), so each level looks denser. `maxParticles` sets it by hand, as in the last box; it never goes past `360`.

asChild.title: On a button (asChild)
asChild.description: With `asChild`, the rain goes straight onto the gem-system `Button`, without an extra `div`. This one uses `trigger="hover"` and `variant="light"`, so it also rains when you Tab to the button. The button needs enough size for the rain to show. With a void element like `` or ``, which can't have children, the effect falls back to the wrapping `div`.

state.title: Paused and disabled
state.description: `isPaused` freezes the particles on screen and stops emission; the timers that remove them and the `span` timer pause too, so they stay put until you resume. `isDisabled` stops emission (particles already falling finish) and keeps the content interactive.

callbacks.title: Events
callbacks.description: `onParticleRain` fires when emission starts and `outParticleRain` when emission stops and the last particles finish, with the reason in `event.reason`. This one uses `trigger="click"`: the inner button still gets its click and also starts the rain, because `pointerdown` bubbles up to the root. Activating it with Enter or Space starts the rain too.

texts.body: Click the button (or activate it with the keyboard): it bumps the counter and starts the rain.

header.title: ParticleRain API
header.description: Reference for props, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types of `ParticleRain`.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples for each variant, trigger, and option.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from `@gem-org/gemffects/particle-rain` with `particles.css` (the particles) and `particle-rain.css` (the root), or from the package root if you already load `styles.css`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> (except color) and forwards them to the root div (or the child, with asChild). onPointerDown, onPointerEnter, onPointerLeave, onClick, onKeyDown, onKeyUp, onFocus, and onBlur run before the effect's internal logic. ref is merged with the internal ref that measures the root. style reaches the root unchanged: the effect writes no variables on it.

items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce no particles are created; the child stays the same. onParticleRain still fires when emission starts, even though nothing shows.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion (or the gemfx-ignore-reduced-motion class on an ancestor) keeps the rain. Use it only when motion is essential.
items.decorative: The layer has aria-hidden and pointer-events: none: it isn't announced and doesn't block clicks.
items.keyboard: Activating a focusable child with Enter or Space starts the rain with click. If the root is the focused element (with asChild on a button, or with tabIndex), Enter and Space start it with click and, with hold, it rains while you hold the key until you release it or focus leaves. With hover, keyboard focus (:focus-visible) on the root or inside turns the rain and its events on.
items.touch: With trigger="hold" the root sets touch-action: none, so touch can't scroll starting from the effect. disabledOnTouch ignores touches and restores touch-action: auto; mouse and pen keep working.
items.density: With always, the rain never stops and sits above the content (z-index: 1). Over text, use intensity="sm" or a span so it doesn't compete with reading.

items.variant: Active variant. It has no styles of its own: each particle's class sets the look.
items.hold: Added with `trigger="hold"`. Sets `user-select: none` and `touch-action: none`. The end of the gesture is heard on `window`, without capturing the pointer, so children get their `click`.
items.paused: Added with `isPaused`. Pauses particles with `animation-play-state`; the timers pause in JS.
items.inactive: Added with `isActive={false}`. Hides the particles on screen.
items.surface: Wraps the child (`z-index: 0`). With `asChild`, the class goes on the child itself.
items.layer: Particles layer (`position: absolute`, `inset: 0`, `z-index: 1`, `overflow: hidden`, `aria-hidden`). `--rain` sets the linear easing and end scale.
items.particle: Each particle. The variant class sets the shape: radius for `confetti`, glow for `spark` and `light`, and a four-point `clip-path` for `star`. `light` uses its own keyframes.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: The duration is written inline on the layer and per-particle values go inline on each particle. The motion ones come from the layer class.

items.particleDuration: Duration of each particle. Set by `duration` and inline on the layer; to override it from CSS, declare it on `.gemfx-particle`. JS removes each particle after `duration + 210` ms, so a longer duration set from CSS gets cut off.
items.motion: Easing (`--gemfx-easing-linear`), initial vertical offset (`0%`), and end scale (`0.55`). Set by `.gemfx-particle-layer--rain` and overridable with a class.
items.particle: Origin, travel, rotation, size, color, and delay of each particle. Computed in JS on every wave.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global variables ParticleRain reads as defaults. Palettes are only used when you pass neither `colors` nor `color`.

content.title: Content
content.description: What the rain falls over and where the effect mounts.

timing.title: Timing
timing.description: Fall, delay, emission, and interval, in milliseconds.

state.title: Trigger and state
state.description: When it rains, how it pauses, and how it turns off.

items.asChild: Applies the effect to the single child, without a wrapping `div`. With void elements like `img` it falls back to the `div`.
items.variant: `confetti` is paper bits, `spark` glowing streaks, `star` sparkles, `light` glowing orbs, and `mixed` a random shape per particle.
items.color: A single color. Used when `colors` is omitted.
items.count: Particles per wave (`1` to `24`). Wins over `intensity`.
items.spread: Maximum sideways drift, in pixels. Wins over `intensity`.
items.intensity: Without `count` or `spread`: `3` / `6` / `10` particles per wave and `18` / `36` / `56` px of drift.
items.maxParticles: Most live particles at once; waves past it are trimmed. When omitted, it fits the steady stream (`count` × waves alive during one fall). Never below `count` or above `360`.
items.duration: How long each particle takes to fall.
items.span: How long emission lasts. With `click`, `1400` by default; otherwise, no limit.
items.trigger: `always` rains constantly, `hover` while the pointer is over it or it has keyboard focus, `click` starts a `span` ms shower (also with Enter or Space), and `hold` rains while the pointer or key is pressed.
items.isActive: Allows emission. When `false`, stops it and hides the particles on screen.
items.isPaused: Freezes the particles on screen, their timers, and emission.
items.isDisabled: Stops emission; the child stays interactive.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Shows the rain even when the user prefers less motion. Only when essential.
items.disabledOnTouch: Ignores touch pointers; mouse and pen keep working.
items.onParticleRain: Fires when emission starts: on mount with `always`, on pointer or focus enter, on click, or on hold (pointer or keyboard).
items.outParticleRain: Fires when emission stops and the last particles finish, or on unmount.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
